caption: The drawing shows a wooden bucket with vertical planks forming the cylindrical body, bound at the top and bottom by two horizontal bands of wood. The bucket features a single tall handle attached at the back, which curves upward and is shaped for gripping. The wooden texture is detailed with brown and tan shades, showing the grain and natural irregularities of the wood. The bucket is positioned centrally on a plain, light-colored background, with a thin rectangular border enclosing the drawing. Shadows and color variations are used to depict depth and dimension in the wooden planks and bands. The artist's signature, "Annie B. Johnston," appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Piggin
